instruction:
1. Revise the PowerPoint presentation according to the notes on each slide.
2. Move the table-of-contents slide to the second slide, then shift the other slides back in sequence without disrupting their order.

dim1: The delivered file is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened normally.
The delivered PowerPoint presentation contains 23 slides.
The slides in the delivered PowerPoint presentation are in a continuous sequence, with no blank slides, duplicate slides, or slides that cannot be displayed.
The delivered PowerPoint presentation remains editable as a whole; it must not be exported in its entirety as an image-based PowerPoint presentation or as non-editable PDF-style content.

The delivered PowerPoint presentation does not have severe content disorder, extensive text overlap, objects overflowing beyond slide boundaries, or unreadable slide content on more than 50% of its slides.
dim2: +5: Slide order adjustment: Slide 1 is the cover slide, “Improvement Report on the Debris Separation and Condition Monitoring Device for the High-Speed Forming Line”; Slide 2 contains “TABLE OF CONTENTS” and “CONTENTS”; Slides 3 through 23 are, in order, “Project Positioning,” “Risk Mechanism: Three Factors Overlap,” “Before Modification: Long Recovery Path and Few Observation Points,” “Modification Goal: Break Apart the Risk Chain,” “Requirements Translation: From On-Site Feedback to Key Requirements,” “Innovation Reference: Segmentation and Advance Sensing,” “Goal Setting: Constrain the Design with Quantifiable Metrics,” “Feasibility Analysis: Evaluation across Three Dimensions—Process, Technology, and Resources,” “Simulation Test One: Screening Path Validation,” “Simulation Test Two: Powder Content and Abnormality Propagation Trend,” “Overall Solution: Physical Routing + Online Condition Sensing,” “R&D Metrics: Functionality, Performance, and Compatibility,” “Formulate Countermeasures: Tasks, Goals, and Deliverables,” “Countermeasure Implementation One: Screening System Design and Fabrication,” “Countermeasure Implementation Two: Fabrication of an Openable Observation Window,” “Countermeasure Implementation Three: Integrate the Monitoring Display into the Operator Station,” “Overall Trial Run: Results Across Consecutive Shifts,” “Results Verification: The Risk Chain Is Weakened,” “Standardization and Consolidation Measures,” “Summary and Outlook,” and “Thank You for Listening.”

+5: Chapter-label text groups: “01 Background” appears at the top right of Slides 3, 4, and 5; “02 Goal” appears at the top right of Slide 6; “03 Requirements” appears at the top right of Slides 7 and 8; “04 Goal” appears at the top right of Slides 9 and 10; “05 Validation” appears at the top right of Slides 11 and 12; “06 Solution” appears at the top right of Slides 13 and 14; “07 Implementation” appears at the top right of Slides 15, 16, 17, and 18; “08 Validation” appears at the top right of Slides 19 and 20; and “09 Consolidation” appears at the top right of Slide 21. All of these text elements are positioned 27cm–32.5cm from the left and 0.8cm–1.8cm from the top, use Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt, and are light green with font color code 00A6A6, red 0, green 166, blue 166.

+1: Slide 2 table-of-contents title text: “TABLE OF CONTENTS” and “CONTENTS” appear in the upper-left or upper-center area of Slide 2. The “TABLE OF CONTENTS” text uses Microsoft YaHei at 40 pt, is white, and has color code FFFFFF. “CONTENTS” uses an English sans-serif font at approximately 10 pt, is bold, is light green, and has color code 99F6E4. The table-of-contents title does not obscure any of the six table-of-contents sections.

+3: Text in the six sections on the Slide 2 table of contents: Slide 2 contains “01 Project Background and Requirements,” “02 Goal Setting and Feasibility,” “03 Solution Design and Selection,” “04 Implementation Process,” “05 Results Verification,” and “06 Standardization and Outlook.” The titles of all six sections use Microsoft YaHei at 30 pt, are white, and have color code FFFFFF; they retain a vertical or grouped arrangement and have no obvious text overlap.

+3: Three images inserted on Slide 4: Slide 4 contains three images. The three images are arranged from left to right or from top to bottom; each image has an aspect ratio of approximately 4:3 and a light-blue single solid-line border with a line width of 0.75–1.5 pt. They do not obscure the slide's existing text, including “Powder Debris,” “Residual Hot Spots,” and “Enclosed Accumulation.”
+1: Slide 5 table and video settings: The text in the table in the middle of the slide uses Microsoft YaHei at 10 pt, and the table text remains editable;

+5: The video object on the left side of Slide 5 is set to play automatically upon entering the slide. The video object remains within the main content area of the slide and does not obscure the title or table.

+1: Slide 6 goal-keyword text: The three words “Separation,” “Observation,” and “Maintenance” all use Microsoft YaHei at 15 pt. The three words are positioned as the main titles of the three respective modules and are light green, dark blue, and orange, with color codes 00A6A6, 1D4ED8, and F97316, respectively.

+1: Slide 7 requirements-table text: All cell text in the slide's table uses Microsoft YaHei at 10 pt. The table retains the three column headers “Source,” “Revised On-Site Feedback,” and “Key Requirements,” as well as three rows of content. The table borders and the “Core Requirements” note at the bottom are not noticeably misaligned.

+5: Uniform sizing of the three images on Slide 8: The slide contains three images, each 8cm wide and 5cm high, with an allowed tolerance of ±0.2cm. The positions of the three images do not obscure body text such as “Principle A | Segmentation,” “Principle B | Prior Action,” and “Combined Direction.”

+5: Expansion of the Slide 9 goal-description text: The explanatory text at the bottom of the slide is expanded from “Goal setting uses range-based and function-based expressions to avoid tying it to proprietary data from an actual production line.” into a complete sentence of approximately 50 characters. The text still conveys the framing of goal setting, range-based expression, function-based expression, and the meaning of public communication. It uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt, is light green with color code 00A6A6, and does not extend beyond the visible area at the bottom of the slide.

+3: Slide 10 image animation effect: A dynamic effect is applied to the main image object or graphic object on the slide. The animated object is located in the slide's main image area; the animation is not applied to all text across the entire slide and does not cause table text to disappear or become misaligned.

+5: Slide 11 validation-slide modifications: The “Validation Conclusion” text is expanded to more than 50 characters, with content centered on optimizing single-layer screen-surface routing, aperture pattern, angle, and sealing boundaries. The font is Microsoft YaHei, size 13, and the color is black;
+3: The main image object on Slide 11 has the Wheel animation effect applied.

+1: Slide 12 test-description text: The sentence at or near the bottom of the slide, “This test is used only to determine process trends and is not a record of combustion testing in an actual production environment.” uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt, is dark gray with color code 64748B, appears in full, and does not extend beyond its text box.
+1: Slide 13 design principles: Five lines of text appear below “Design Principles.”

+1: Slide 14 R&D metrics table: The table text uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt and is dark blue with color code 334155. The table still contains the three column headers “Category,” “Requirement,” and “Revised Evaluation Method,” as well as five rows for functionality, safety, monitoring, compatibility, and cost. The note at the bottom, “The metrics have been converted into terms suitable for public communication and do not include original procurement amounts, supply channels, or actual hardware models.” uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt and is dark gray with color code 64748B.

+1: Slide 15 implementation-slide text replacement: The text “Project Coordination Lead: Shen Yiran” appears in the “Responsible Role” column of the last row of the table. Its font and font size match the other table text in the same column, and the table's other content remains editable.

+1: Font size of text on Slide 16, Implementation 1: The three sentences “The elongated-hole screen surface balances separation efficiency and clogging risk,” “Allow the material to move forward naturally under gravity and vibration,” and “Reduce powder leakage and accumulation along the enclosure edges” all use Microsoft YaHei at 15 pt, are dark gray with color code 334155, and are located within the explanatory areas for Steps 1, 2, and 3, respectively.

+1: Slide 17 Implementation 2 table and animation: The table text uses Microsoft YaHei at 10 pt. The table still contains the text “Inspection Item,” “Test Result,” “Ease of Opening and Closing,” “Internal Visibility,” and “Maintenance and Cleaning.” The text is dark gray with color code 334155.
+3: The main image object on Slide 17 has the Fade animation effect applied.

+3: Slide 18 animation: The main image object on the slide has the Dissolve animation effect applied. The image remains within the slide's main content area and does not obscure the three text groups “Display Coverage,” “Independent Signal,” and “Inspection Records.”

+1: Slide 19 Excel data table: The table at the top of the slide contains the data from Sheet1!A1:D6 of the uploaded Excel file. The column headers are “Evaluation Item,” “Solution A: Compact Production Line,” “Solution B: Standardized Production Line,” and “Solution C: Intelligent Flexible Production Line”; the row items are “Single-Line Capacity,” “Process Configuration,” “Maintenance Space,” “Operating Stability,” and “Overall Focus.” The table's overall height is 10.59cm and its width is 24.07cm, with an allowed tolerance of ±0.2cm, and the table text is editable.

+1: Specific data in the Excel table on Slide 19: The table on Slide 19 contains Excel data text including “Approximately 7,200 units/hour,” “Approximately 9,600 units/hour,” “Online Inspection + Sectioned Dust Removal,” “Conventional Conveying + Centralized Extraction,” “Visual Recognition + Closed-Loop Adjustment + Graded Recovery,” and “Coordination of Dust Accumulation, Temperature-Rise Warnings, and Blind-Spot Inspections.” The data order matches the Excel table's left-to-right, top-to-bottom order.

+3: Colors of the risk-chain circles on Slide 20: The circle above “Fuel Side” has a red fill and a red outline; the circle above “Detection Side” has a yellow fill and a yellow outline. The diameters of both circles match those of the other similar circles on the slide, and the circles do not obscure the title text below them.

+1: Slide 21 consolidation-measures note: The text at the bottom of the slide, “Next step: Based on the spatial differences among different production lines, create an adjustable installation package and an inspection-instruction card.” uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt, is dark blue with color code 0A1F33, appears in full within the explanatory area at the bottom of the slide, and does not extend beyond the slide boundaries.

+1: Slide 22 Summary and Outlook text: The Slide 22 title, “Summary and Outlook,” uses Microsoft YaHei at 40 pt, is white with color code FFFFFF, and is located in the upper-left or upper-center title area. The text at the bottom of the slide, “Future direction: Integrate image recognition with cleaning records to enable alerts for abnormal trends and retain inspection data.” uses Microsoft YaHei at 20 pt, is white with color code FFFFFF, appears in full, and does not obscure the three content groups “Small Modification,” “Strong Visibility,” and “Easy Maintenance.”

+1: Slide 23 thank-you-slide title: “Thank You for Listening” on Slide 23 uses Microsoft YaHei at 40 pt, is white with color code FFFFFF, and is located in the center or upper-center area of the slide. “Please provide criticism and guidance” and “Continuous improvement makes hidden risks visible and manageable.” still appear in full, and the text is editable.
